statement_en: Under daily energy conservation eps dm = a I - (R + Act + s a I) with SDA coefficient s, a design that does not take in at least (R + Act) / (a (1 - s)) loses mass; a claim to hold or gain mass on less is ruled out.

hypotheses.name: see theorem statement
hypotheses.statement: the named hypothesis structure(s) in the theorem statement; instantiated with fetched numbers in Delphi.Perturb.measured

scope.basis: SDA coefficients from walleye (Bihun 2024) and larval clownfish (McLeod and Clark 2016); energy conservation itself is general
